title: 第7章 族长来援第8章 激烈的战斗

第7章族长来援
两个时辰后，四长老刘百川通过传音符告诉了众人他实地观察后得到的情况。
这是一群青风狼正在狩猎金角鹿，共有青风狼15只，其中:一阶上品青风狼2只、一阶中品青风狼4只、一阶下品青风狼9只。
青风狼的特点是奔行速度快，耐力好，生性狡猾，善于群体捕猎，血脉妖术是风刃术，缺点是青风狼肉身不强。
被青风狼狩猎的金角鹿共有12只，鹿群在一阶上品金角鹿王的带领下，正在不断与狼群周旋，企图冲出狼群的包围，由于金角鹿的耐力不如青风狼，鹿群的处境很不妙。
金角鹿浑身都是宝，它的速度快，血脉妖术金角术，也具有较强的攻击力。然而，巨大的金角也使得它的战斗灵活性不足，耐力不如青风狼，在与青风狼的战斗中常常处于下风。
对于以金角鹿为食的青风狼来说，它们很清楚金角鹿的弱点，并且善于利用自己的优势，凭借超凡耐力，捕猎金角鹿。
青风狼对付金角鹿常常采用如下战术：狼群先轮换派出少数青风狼，不断骚扰袭击金角鹿群，驱赶金角鹿群不断逃跑，而狼群则跟在鹿群后面不停追击，在将鹿群弄得筋疲力尽，妖力枯竭后，才会全力攻击，因此，常常能以较小的代价获得丰厚的战果。
只是采用这种战术，狼群需要的时间较多，往往需要几天几夜才能结束战斗。
根据四长老刘百川提供的情报，族长刘百山决定抓住这个有利时机一举消灭青风狼和金角鹿群。
因此，族长要求四长老刘百川在他带着族人赶来支援前，不得轻举妄动，要继续跟踪监视狼群和鹿群的动向。
同时要求刘世杰继续带领猎妖队在营地中等候，待族长带领支援队伍赶到后，一同出发去消灭狼群和鹿群。
在经过一番等待后，族长刘百山在第二天上午带着十五人的支援队伍赶到营地，与猎妖队汇合在一起。
族长刘百山是刘长旭的亲爷爷，今年82岁，国字脸，身材壮硕。他是刘家百字辈老五，炼气大圆满修为，金木火土四灵根，一阶上品灵植师和炼器师。
刘百山共有妻妾五人，这五个妻妾一共给他生育了十二个儿子和13个女儿，但是，有灵根的孩子却只有两个儿子和一个女儿。
分别是刘长旭的父亲，世字辈老七刘世昊、世字辈老十六刘世安、世字辈老十九刘世兰，这还是父母是修仙者的缘故。
凡人生育有灵根的子嗣机率更低，只有千分之一，每年家族都有数百上千人的孩童达到检测灵根的年龄，但是，每年检测出灵根的孩童只有两三个，有的年份甚至没有，而检测出灵根的孩童，绝大部分又是修仙者的后代，来自凡俗的则少之又少。
所以，一般修仙家族都会要求男性家族修士到了生育年龄就娶妻纳妾，多多生育子嗣。
没办法，由于修士是家族的守卫者，家族修士如果后继无人，家族必将走向衰败，甚至灭亡。在这个危机四伏的世界，没有强者的守护，是无力在这个世界生存的。
刘氏家族族规就要求家族修士到了婚育年龄必须娶妻生子，并对生育出有灵根孩子的父母有灵石奖励。

还有一个原因是为了与周边家族搞好关系，修仙家族经常会与其他修仙家族联姻。刘长旭的父亲母亲就是这样结合的。
其实，很多修士为了心中的大道，不愿意早早的娶妻生子的，但是，很多都在残酷的现实面前选择了妥协。
在族长刘百山带来的支援队伍中，刘长旭的父亲刘世昊、母亲林玉莲、叔叔刘世安、姑姑刘世兰均来了。
刘长旭急忙见过爷爷刘百山、父亲刘世昊、母亲林玉莲、叔叔刘世安、姑姑刘世兰。
母亲林玉莲看到刘长旭后，先是仔细打量着刘长旭，看到刘长旭并没有受伤后，才放下心来。
刘长旭在看到亲人关切的目光后，将自己这两天的经历，简单的介绍一遍，最后说道:“爷爷、父亲、母亲、叔叔、姑姑，你们放心吧！我有能力保护自己、保护家族！”
说着，刘长旭将自己猎杀的那只青狐皮毛从储物袋中拿了出来，送给母亲林玉莲道：“这是我独自杀的第一只妖兽，它的皮毛很好看，我今天送给母亲，希望您能喜欢！”
母亲林玉莲高兴的眼泪都下来了，点点头，高兴的说到:“我家的旭儿长大了，懂事了，也有本事了娘很高兴！”然后，欢喜的接过了狐皮收进了储物袋中。
接着，刘长旭又将青狐幼崽小青从灵兽袋中取出来，萌萌可爱的小青让母亲高兴不已，在她眼中，儿子的收获都是自己的收获，儿子有本事让她更加放心。
刘家众修士休整完毕后，在族长刘百山的带领下，开始向着刘百川指引的方向前进。
很快刘家众人就来到了预定地点，这是一处群山环绕的谷地，只有四条通往谷外的山道，是一处绝佳的伏击之地。
狼群目前还在狩猎金角鹿群，由于狼群和鹿群的战斗还在激烈的进行，到现在鹿群和狼群均已疲惫不堪，正是刘家攻击的好时机。
尤其是金角鹿群此时也处于绝对劣势中，已经被狼群杀死了五只金角鹿。
鹿王身上已是伤痕累累，其它的金角鹿也均受了轻重不一的伤势，过不了多久，这群金角鹿就会被狼群杀死。
青风狼群也遭受了一定损失，两只青风狼被金角鹿群所杀，三只青风狼受伤。
刘家众位修士在族长刘百山的安排下，一共分成四组，把守四条通向谷外的通道，防止狼群和鹿群突围而去。
此时，狼群和鹿群都已发现了刘家众修士到来。
狼王非常狡猾，立即知晓了刘家众修士的意图。
于是狼王立即带领狼群果断选择一条通道突围，
金角鹿群则在鹿王的带领下选择向着相反一条通道突围。

于是，一场非常激烈的战斗开始了。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 7 The clan leader comes to help
Two hours later, the Fourth Elder Liu Baichuan told everyone through the transmission talismans the situation he had obtained after on-site observation.
This is a group of Qingfeng wolves hunting golden-horned deer. There are 15 Qingfeng wolves in total, including: 2 first-order high-grade Qingfeng wolves, 4 first-order mid-grade Qingfeng wolves, and 9 first-order low-grade Qingfeng wolves.
The characteristics of Qingfeng Wolf are fast running speed, good endurance, cunning nature, and good at hunting in groups. The bloodline magic is wind blade technique. The disadvantage is that Qingfeng Wolf is not physically strong.
There are 12 golden-horned deer hunted by Qingfeng Wolf. The deer herd, led by the first-level high-grade Golden-horned Deer King, are constantly dealing with the wolves, trying to break out of the wolf pack. Since the endurance of the golden-horned deer is not as good as the Qingfeng Wolf, the deer herd are in a very bad situation.
The Golden Horned Deer is full of treasures. It is fast, has bloodline magic, the Golden Horn Technique, and also has strong attack power. However, its huge golden horns also make it less flexible in combat, and its endurance is not as good as the Qingfeng Wolf. It is often at a disadvantage in battles with the Qingfeng Wolf.
For Qingfeng wolves that feed on golden-horned deer, they are well aware of the golden-horned deer's weaknesses and are good at using their own advantages to hunt golden-horned deer with their extraordinary endurance.
Green wind wolves often use the following tactics to deal with golden-horned deer: the wolf pack first sends out a small number of green wind wolves in rotation, constantly harassing and attacking the golden-horned deer herd, driving the golden-horned deer herd to flee, while the wolf pack follows the deer herd and pursues them. After the deer herd is exhausted and their demonic power is exhausted, they will attack with all their strength. Therefore, they can often obtain rich results at a relatively small cost.
However, using this tactic requires more time for the wolves, and it often takes several days and nights to end the battle.
According to the information provided by the fourth elder Liu Baichuan, the clan leader Liu Baishan decided to seize this favorable opportunity to eliminate the Qingfeng Wolf and Golden Horn Deer herds in one fell swoop.
Therefore, the clan leader asked Liu Baichuan, the fourth elder, not to act rashly and to continue to track and monitor the movements of the wolves and deer before he and his clan members arrived for support.
At the same time, Liu Shijie was asked to continue to lead the demon hunting team to wait in the camp, and when the support team led by the clan leader arrived, they set out together to eliminate the wolves and deer.
After waiting for a while, the clan leader Liu Baishan rushed to the camp with a support team of fifteen people the next morning and joined the demon hunting team.
The patriarch Liu Baishan is Liu Changxu's grandfather. He is 82 years old this year, has a Chinese character face and a strong build. He is the fifth eldest son of the Liu family. He has attained the Great Perfection in Qi refining, has the four spiritual roots of metal, wood, fire and earth, and is a first-level high-grade spiritual planter and weapon refiner.
Liu Baishan had a total of five wives and concubines. These five wives and concubines gave him a total of 12 sons and 13 daughters. However, he only had two sons and one daughter with spiritual roots.
They are Liu Changxu's fathers, Liu Shihao, the seventh generation, Liu Shi'an, the sixteenth generation, and Liu Shilan, the nineteenth generation. This is because their parents are immortal cultivators.
The chance of a mortal giving birth to an heir with spiritual roots is even lower, only one in a thousand. Every year, hundreds of children in the family reach the age of detecting spiritual roots. However, there are only two or three children with spiritual roots detected every year, and some years there are even none. Most of the children with spiritual roots detected are the descendants of immortal cultivators, and there are very few from ordinary people.
Therefore, generally cultivating families will require male family monks to marry and take concubines when they reach childbearing age, so as to have more children.
There is no way, because the monks are the guardians of the family, if there are no successors to the family monks, the family will inevitably decline or even perish. In this crisis-ridden world, it is impossible to survive in this world without the protection of a strong person.
The Liu family's clan rules require that monks in the family must marry and have children when they reach the age of marriage, and parents who give birth to children with spiritual roots will be rewarded with spiritual stones.
Another reason is that in order to have good relations with surrounding families, the Immortal Cultivating Family often marries with other Immortal Cultivating Families. This is how Liu Changxu's father and mother were combined.
In fact, many monks, for the sake of their heartsThose who are on the high road are not willing to marry early and have children, but many of them choose to compromise in the face of the cruel reality.
Among the support team brought by the patriarch Liu Baishan, Liu Changxu's father Liu Shihao, mother Lin Yulian, uncle Liu Shi'an, and aunt Liu Shilan all came.
Liu Changxu hurriedly met his grandfather Liu Baishan, his father Liu Shihao, his mother Lin Yulian, his uncle Liu Shian, and his aunt Liu Shilan.
After her mother Lin Yulian saw Liu Changxu, she looked at him carefully and then felt relieved after seeing that Liu Changxu was not injured.
After seeing the concerned eyes of his relatives, Liu Changxu briefly introduced his experiences in the past two days and finally said: "Grandpa, father, mother, uncles, aunts, don't worry! I have the ability to protect myself and my family!"
As he spoke, Liu Changxu took out the fur of the green fox he had hunted from the storage bag and gave it to his mother, Lin Yulian, saying: "This is the first monster I killed alone. Its fur is very beautiful. I am giving it to my mother today. I hope you like it!"
Mother Lin Yulian shed tears of joy, nodded, and said happily: "My Xu'er has grown up, is sensible, and has abilities. Mom is very happy!" Then, she happily took the fox skin and put it into the storage bag.
Then, Liu Changxu took out the green fox cub Xiaoqing from the spirit beast bag. The cute Xiaoqing made his mother very happy. In her eyes, her son's gains were all her own, and her son's ability made her even more reassured.
After the monks of the Liu family finished resting, under the leadership of the clan leader Liu Baishan, they began to move in the direction directed by Liu Baichuan.
Soon everyone in the Liu family arrived at the predetermined location. This was a valley surrounded by mountains. There were only four mountain roads leading out of the valley, making it an excellent place for an ambush.
The wolves are still hunting the golden-antlered deer group. Since the battle between the wolf group and the deer group is still fierce, both the deer group and the wolf group are now exhausted. It is a good time for the Liu family to attack.
In particular, the golden-antlered deer herd was at an absolute disadvantage at this time, and five golden-antlered deer had already been killed by wolves.
The deer king's body was already covered in scars, and the other golden-horned deer also suffered injuries of varying severity. It wouldn't be long before these golden-horned deer would be killed by the wolves.
The Qingfeng wolves also suffered certain losses. Two Qingfeng wolves were killed by the golden-horned deer herd, and three Qingfeng wolves were injured.
Under the arrangement of the patriarch Liu Baishan, the monks of the Liu family were divided into four groups to guard the four passages leading out of the valley to prevent wolves and deer from breaking through.
At this time, the wolves and deer had discovered the arrival of the Liu family monks.
The Wolf King was very cunning and immediately knew the intentions of the Liu family monks.
So the wolf king immediately led the wolves to decisively choose a passage to break out.
The herd of golden-antlered deer, led by the Deer King, chose to break through the opposite passage.
So, a very fierce battle began.
(End of chapter)
